A_B_native.B: Fifteen existing revisions chiefly preserve own-parish f.d. occupation, street21/foster-chain older grounds, source-field completion reservations, money-column separation, residence precision and gate distinction; three sex attributes directly follow printed categories. Charlotta source-birthplace variant is the material unsupported subset.
A_B_native.scope_judgment: Additional A/B repairs beyond Astra reference are supported within the selected families/source-effect review, with the identified B exception. No new person identities, parent edges or gate uplift; not proof of exhaustive relevant-copy coverage.

limits: Two readers of one image provide quality control, not two independent historical witnesses.
Accepted final reference is distinguished from initial Astra/Sol raw readings and documentary whole reuse. Its reused glyphs are not newly reread truth by definition.
No numerical accuracy score: reference256new+63reuse logical fields, candidate subdivisions/claims and selected key-field checks have different denominators.
Raw mark omissions differ from false substantive facts; reservations differ from certain errors.
Older originals outside the five were not reopened. A/B documentary support coherence is assessed from exact frozen j227 fields and support versions.
Coverage remains PARTIAL; no additional candidate repair or new research was performed.

A/B additional new source/adoption objects were checked for the identified source-effect reservations and preserved gates; this report does not claim an exhaustive independent proof of every added support assertion. Supported existing-revision judgments concern the concrete changed wording, not all untouched object data.
conclusion: Source quality does not pass: definite B birthplace transfer and D1830 source-conflict are material; E63 certainty lacks sufficient source support. A/B supported extra consolidation does not erase these errors or the separate CDE reference coverage failures.
